description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dagonna, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the process of calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without a will) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The notice is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding the registration of land titles, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
